mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 73 degrees under overcast skies near City Hall with a First Quarter moon overhead, though we have no visible ISS sightings tonight.

Stay informed about our city by watching VHAT on channel 989 for government meetings and updates, and remember to follow local ordinances for parking recreational vehicles, such as keeping them at least 5 feet from property lines.

Your calendar is packed this week with plenty of fun, including trivia at Hop Haus on Tuesday, the downtown farmers market on Wednesday at Hometown Junction Park, and live music kicking off at Century School Park this Thursday.
In our weekly police report, on July 14, an officer stopped a vehicle for driving without headlights and ended up seizing marijuana, drug paraphernalia, and a firearm during the investigation.
Today, you can grab a scoop of the delicious Chocolate Caramel Twist. Our local Culver's is currently closed but will open its doors at 10 AM to serve you.
